findings.finding: Audio observation time/duration is seconds. Score time uses measure plus beat/10, not elapsed seconds or a linear bar fraction. The beat origin and unit vary across parsers.

Current Winterreise directories list24 score JAMS and216 audio JAMS. Group all score/audio/transposed performances by original workID Schubert_D911-XX, not distinct JAMS IDs. Winterreise overlaps the earlier OpenScore D911 source family and must not be called unseen.

The9 inspected JAMS contain chord/key/meter/structure namespaces, no note-level melody stream. Nottingham raw ABC contains melodic pitches and rhythms; the ChoCo conversion extracts harmonic annotations rather than retaining note events. Rock selected .har files are harmonic macros/analyses; original work audio/lyrics were not retrieved. Winterreise inspected raw directories contain annotation CSVs, not score-note MIDI.

recommendation: Do not train from converted Rock JAMS in this task. For any future intake, pin original annotations, preserve annotator/source lineage and per-parser timing semantics; group derivative representations and all performances by work before splitting. This is a schema audit, not a fresh licensing clearance or whole-corpus validation.
